findings.evidence: "This workspace holds 4 projects, synced this morning." but the list below contains only 3 items: Beta Launch Plan, Holiday Campaign Assets, Partner Integration Pilot
findings.fix: Either add one more project to the list or change the text to "This workspace holds 3 projects, synced this morning."
findings.violation: The stated project count does not match the number of projects actually listed.

findings.evidence: `<button id="project-settings-duplicate-btn" type="button" aria-label="Duplicate project"></button>` has no text content between the tags
findings.fix: Add visible text inside the button, like `<button id="project-settings-duplicate-btn" type="button" aria-label="Duplicate project">Duplicate</button>`, or include an icon with descriptive content.
findings.violation: The button is empty and provides no visible label for sighted users, relying entirely on the aria-label for understanding.

findings.evidence: The section contains both a form with a submit button (`id="invite-member-save-btn"`) and a separate "Continue" link (`id="invite-member-continue-link"`) that both appear to advance the workflow
findings.fix: Remove the separate Continue link and ensure the form's submit button action navigates to the next state, or restructure so the Continue link only becomes visible after successful form submission.
findings.violation: It is unclear whether the form submission or the separate Continue link triggers the next step, and showing both simultaneously creates ambiguity in the intended user flow.
